from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u097/system/state/workspace/programs')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # A diagonal pair marks a colored line; extend its two exposed ends.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color):
                    continue
                # Continue the line outward from either end of the pair.
                for sr, sc, step_r, step_c in ((r, c, -dr, -dc), (rr, cc, dr, dc)):
                    nr, nc = sr + step_r, sc + step_c
                    while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and out[nr][nc] == bg:
                        out[nr][nc] = color
                        nr += step_r
                        nc += step_c
    return out
'''
